notes:
Summary: Lodestar (mid-market B2B SaaS, customer success platform) completed a 3-week Hosted API trial and is evaluating Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation. They like the API ergonomics and streaming but need clearer capex/commit pricing and a detailed capacity plan before procurement.

Trial metrics (hosted API):
- Trial period: 2026-01-29 to 2026-02-19.
- Observed steady-state QPS (business hours): ~2.3 QPS average; spike days up to 8 QPS.
- Peak concurrent requests observed: 45 (during a product launch simulation).
- Token mix observed: ~85% short interactions (<=512 tokens roundtrip), 15% long-context summarization jobs (avg ~4k tokens).
- Nightly batch jobs: nightly embedding runs processing ~1.2M documents (done via chunked embedding jobs off-peak).
- Latency targets: p50 target 120ms, p95 target <600ms; hosted trial p95 occasionally hitting 800-1,200ms on peak.

Dedicated needs and sizing ask:
- Customer requests recommendation for a 3-tier Dedicated commit: baseline, burst, and disaster fallback.
- Baseline forecast for year 1: 15 QPS sustained, with 120 peak concurrent model-inference tokens flow; expected growth to 60 QPS sustained by end of year 1 (product roadmap).
- Token throughput estimate: baseline token/s ~50k tokens/sec (mix weighted by short vs long jobs).
- Requested SLOs: p95 latency <400ms for chat flows, batch embeddings can be lower priority.
- Wants autoscale/burst plan and explicit fallback routing to hosted variants for overflow.

Security & procurement:
- SOC2 report received and under legal review.
- Need explicit KMS integration details and audit log retention policy for SOC evidence.
- SSO (SAML) required for admin console access.

Conversations to date (timeline):
- 2025-11-12: Intro call (Jordan) - qualified need; initial architecture notes.
- 2026-01-02: Demo of Hosted API features (streaming, function-calls).
- 2026-01-29: Hosted trial kickoff; trial config included prefix caching enabled.
- 2026-02-18: Walkthrough of hosted trial metrics (Fireflies FF-20260218-42).
- 2026-02-20: Dedicated demo + initial capacity discussion (SE present).
- 2026-02-24: Pricing framework email exchanged (thread-20260215-lodestar-hosted-trial).

Quotes and raw notes from product: "Loved the streaming latency on small prompts; worried about tail during peak launch events."

Open items / blockers:
- Need Redwood to produce a dedicated capacity sizing doc with QPS/concurrency to SKU mapping and estimated token-hours usage.
- Clear pricing for baseline vs burst vs overflow (per-token vs per-hour GPU commit).
- Legal needs tighter SLA language around p95 and data residency guarantees.
